name: Familcar
description: Uruguayan importer and online seller of auto parts for many car makes, including lighting, brakes, filters, suspension and engine parts. Ships nationwide through a transport agency chosen by the customer; Montevideo pickup is available.
description_es: Importador y tienda online uruguaya de repuestos para autos de muchas marcas: iluminación, frenos, filtros, suspensión y motor. Envía a todo el país por la agencia de transporte que elija el cliente; hay retiro en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide; the customer chooses and pays the transport agency, shipping can be paid at destination.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup in Montevideo, Monday to Friday 9:00 to 18:00.
